name: Hermes Agent
description: Self-improving personal agent that builds skills from experience and is reached from a terminal UI or messaging apps.
whatItDoes: Works as a persistent assistant that learns reusable skills while it is used. Users talk to it in the terminal or through Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal or email.
howItWorks: An installer provides the `hermes` command, with subcommands to pick a model, enable tools, run a setup wizard and start the messaging gateway. A built-in learning loop creates and refines skills during use.

requirements.name: LLM provider access
requirements.description: Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint

models: Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, custom endpoints and more
